meta.name: using-git-worktrees
meta.description: Use when starting feature work that needs isolation from current workspace or before executing implementation plans - ensures an isolated workspace exists via native tools or git worktree fallback

copy.tagline: 创建隔离工作区进行特性开发
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在当前工作区外独立开发新功能
copy.tagline_en: Create isolated workspaces for feature development
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to work on a new feature without affecting your current workspace

howto.what: 开始功能开发前，Claude 会先检测当前是否已在隔离工作区；没有就优先用平台原生 worktree 工具创建，没有原生工具才回退到 git worktree，随后装依赖、跑基线测试并报告就绪。
howto.when: 当你要开始需要与当前工作区隔离的功能开发，或在执行实现计划前，Claude 会接管并确保存在隔离工作区；若已在链接 worktree 中则跳过创建。

say.text: 帮我建一个隔离的 worktree 再开始改这个功能
say.note: Claude 会先检测，再创建并跑基线测试

say.text: 就在当前分支改，不要新建 worktree
say.note: Claude 尊重你的选择，就地工作并进入项目设置

say.text: worktree 建好后先跑测试，确认基线是干净的
say.note: Claude 会运行项目测试并报告结果

howto.what_en: Before starting feature work, Claude checks whether you're already in an isolated workspace; if not, it prefers a native worktree tool, falls back to git worktree, then installs dependencies, runs baseline tests and reports readiness.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you start feature work that needs isolation from the current workspace, or before executing implementation plans. If already in a linked worktree, it skips creation.

say_en.text: Set up an isolated worktree before I start this feature.
say_en.note: Claude detects, creates, then runs baseline tests.

say_en.text: Just work in the current branch, no new worktree.
say_en.note: Claude honors it and works in place.

say_en.text: Once the worktree is ready, run the tests to confirm a clean baseline.
say_en.note: Claude runs project tests and reports.
